stock.description: China Qinfa Group Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the coal operation business. It operates under the Coal Business and Shipping Transportation segments. The Coal Business segment includes coal mining, purchases and sales, filtering, storage, and blending of coal. The Shipping Transportation segment offers time charter and voyage charter of vessels. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
